about: Canonical QorCap <-> QorTime contract registry. QorTime owns it; QorCap vendors a byte-identical copy (contracts/ + CONTRACTS_PIN) and its tests fail on drift. Change it here first, then re-vendor.

hash_chain.canonical_json: RFC 8785 JCS, integers only (|n| <= 2^53-1), no floats
hash_chain.signature: Ed25519 over JCS(receipt minus signatures); {key_id, sig}; key_id = 16 hex

rules: |referee_ts_ms - t_ms| <= max_skew_ms for every checkpoint, INCLUDING the last (stop) checkpoint
checkpoint_timing.stop_checkpoint: QorCap >= 0.3.3 writes a 'stop' checkpoint after finalising the video, seals the chain, and waits for the local referee (POST /countersigned) before the slow input-proof work. QorCap <= 0.3.2 had no seal: the tail was countersigned only after the bundle work, tens of seconds late -> gap_too_long + clock_skew on the last checkpoints. The verifiers are right; those recordings cannot be repaired honestly.

challenge_rules.count: one official challenge per phase per role (3); all three answered + re-verified for VERIFIED

open_at.kickoff: first pause-capable moment of the game: quarter 1+ read, game clock seen running (opening kickoff fielded), then a play-call screen came and went (pre-snap)
open_at.halftime: same, in quarter 3+ (after the second-half kickoff)

challenge_rules.why: online Madden 27 cannot pause during a kickoff or kickoff return; OPTIONS works only after a play call
challenge_rules.fallback: if no play-call screen is detected, the recorder opens the window 45 s after the game clock started running in that quarter (gate basis clock_proxy)
challenge_rules.pattern: OPTIONS then 4 face/d-pad buttons from sha256(nonce)
challenge_rules.menu_safe_issue: The referee redraws a fresh nonce until CROSS and CIRCLE are only in the last slot or absent. pattern_for is unchanged, so every existing receipt still verifies.
challenge_rules.response: first OPTIONS press inside [issued_ms, deadline_ms] followed by exactly the pattern

1.default_when: bundle.json has no challenge_rule, or result.rule is absent

2.opt_in: bundle.json challenge_rule = 2; the referee stamps result.rule = 2

challenge_rules.recorder_result: QorCap >= 0.3.11 re-runs each challenge on its own bundle at finalize; an ok result is written to the receipt (reverified_by recorder), anything else stays null with the reason in challenge_results.jsonl
challenge_rules.gate_log: challenge_gates.jsonl: one line per opened window with the gate basis and scorebug state

motion_rules.sample: stratified random: the media span is split into at most 24 equal mono_ms strata and the referee RNG picks one segment per non-empty stratum, drawn only after the submission commit. The drawn seqs are plan.json motion and review.checks.motion.detail.sample_segments
motion_rules.decode_budget: at most 24 media fragments (about 48 s when a fragment is ~2 s), 10 Hz, 640x360; the 240 s tail is the final re-read and is not added to this sample
motion_rules.signal: controller report rate (logged input rows per second); a second with no reports stays zero and is not dropped
motion_rules.scorebug_absent: layout_unknown only, and only after this sample has one ok scorebug read; a second is absent when at least half of its classified frames are layout_unknown; frame_too_small, frame_invalid, and frame_aspect are not absence
motion_rules.challenge_pause: the measured pause span from the challenge re-run, not the issue window and not every dark frame in the match
motion_rules.history: Reviews before motion rule 3 correlated report rate with frame-difference energy over every decoded segment, including the 240 s tail, on the segment close clock, with no live-play exclusions. Those receipts store that integer. The verifier still only compares the stored integer with 300.

3.basis: motion-rule/v3: controller report rate vs frame-difference energy per second on a stratified random spread of at most 24 media segments drawn after commit, timed with the fragment PTS clock (segment close stamps only when a fragment has no tfdt); bins dropped only for referee-measured scorebug absence, end menu, final screen, or challenge pause
3.where: signals.motion_basis and review.checks.motion.detail. Not result.rule. Challenge result.rule stays 1 or 2.
3.receipt_schema: no new receipt.v0.json fields; excluded-bin counts and the sample live in the review check detail and in this registry

rules: equal scores -> tie (legacy receipts with away on a tie still verify)
last_scorebug_read_unconfirmed with no score read -> scores null, winner unknown
last_scorebug_read_unconfirmed keeps the real quarter (>= 1) or null; never forced to 4

official_referee.role: offline root (can_delegate); the service signs with a delegated online key

pairing.body: ignored; the client does not choose pairing_id or nonce
pairing.signed_bytes: RFC 8785 JCS of the token minus sig
pairing.id_nonce: 32 lowercase hex characters each, chosen by the referee

score_timeline.signed_bytes: RFC 8785 JCS of {type, signals, chain, chain_head, checkpoint_head}; signature is not included
score_timeline.signature_receipt_key: Ed25519 hex pub and sig; pub is the receipt player pubkey (QorCap finalize device key)
score_timeline.signature_device_attest_key: same bytes signed by device_attest.v0.json (ECDSA_P256 or RSA_2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256); pub is that SPKI base64 or the hex of the SPKI DER
